audit.identifier_policy: Identifiers preserve original case and whitespace; only empty or whitespace-only identifiers are rejected.
audit.nonfinite_policy: NaN and infinity are invalid input, not missing Ct tokens.
audit.technical_aggregation: Arithmetic mean Ct of available technical wells; sample SD uses n-1.
audit.normalization: delta_ct = target mean Ct - reference mean Ct; log2rq = -(delta_ct - mean complete calibrator delta_ct); rq = 2**log2rq.
audit.calibrator_policy: Mean of complete sample-level delta Ct at exactly the configured group and time; no imputation.
audit.fit_unit: One sample-level normalized observation; technical wells never increase biological N.
audit.normalized_inference_eligible_definition: Technical/normalization quality gate only; design and sampling gates are additional fit-level requirements.
audit.peak_origin: Hours after input time_h=0, modulo period_h; no peak is reported at numerically zero amplitude.
inference_requirements: one run_id in the entire input
no subject sampled at multiple times
at least two valid distinct subjects at every input time for that group, including times with wholly missing measurements
at least four distinct phases modulo period
finite residual variance for nonconstant response
audit.bh_family: All finite zero-amplitude F-test P values across every target gene/group fit in this analyze invocation.
